title: Config messages
skill: Give exact output strings, not their gist

good: Rewrite validate(config) in appconfig/validate.py to return a list of "<key>: <problem>" strings, at most one per key, sorted by key; [] if valid. Problems: missing host or port -> "is required"; key not in host/port/debug/workers/log_level -> "unknown setting"; host not a str or empty after strip -> "must be a non-empty string"; port not an int (bool is not an int) in 1..65535 -> "must be an integer between 1 and 65535"; debug not a bool -> "must be true or false"; workers not an int (not bool) in 1..64 -> "must be an integer between 1 and 64"; log_level not exactly one of debug, info, warning, error -> "must be one of debug, info, warning, error". Use LOG_LEVELS and REQUIRED from appconfig/schema.py. Do not change loader.py. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
lazy: Make validate() report all config errors, not just the first ones.
